stem.text: Which statement suggests that a membrane protein is involved in active transport?

A.text: It allows movement of molecules across a membrane if concentration differences exist.

B.text: It can only function if mitochondria are supplied with sufficient oxygen.

C.text: It has a tertiary structure with a binding site with a specific shape.

D.text: It is found in the cell surface membranes and the mitochondrial membranes.
